principle: generated abundance may surround an anchor; it may not erase the authored exception that gives the place memory

defaults.minimum_retention: near/hero presentation LOD until a human art review explicitly replaces the anchor

anchors.meaning: the same side of a raised threshold has been touched and crossed enough to polish differently
anchors.future_generation: threshold variants may change around it; preserve the local wear asymmetry

anchors.meaning: one upper screen slat was replaced in visibly different wood rather than perfectly matched
anchors.future_generation: screen family may be regenerated; retain one deliberate replacement

anchors.meaning: one short drain segment was repaired in a different stone/material age
anchors.future_generation: drain topology may be optimized; preserve the replacement contrast

anchors.meaning: repeated rope contact has cut a localized groove into an edge post
anchors.future_generation: animal props may vary; retain the worn tether point

anchors.meaning: repeated measuring at one shop edge has left a small sequence of unequal notches
anchors.future_generation: counter/threshold variants may change; retain the local hand-made marks

anchors.meaning: one upper bay carries a repair patch that does not perfectly match the surrounding finish
anchors.future_generation: facade materials may vary; keep a visibly later repair layer

forbidden: turning anchors into collectibles, loot or automatic codex entries
procedurally distributing every anchor to every street
promoting fictional placement into documented 1792 fact
randomizing the exception after it has been deliberately placed
